laws.rule: Ahaggar Cultural Park, named In Salah and Arak access points: Executive Decree 12-291 directs entry through surveillance/control posts. Tourist visits in designated protection zones must be organised through public bodies or licensed tourism agencies and accompanied by a park-appointed guide, approximately one guide per ten visitors. Agency activities in those zones need prior park-office authorisation. This is not a guide requirement throughout the whole wilaya or permission to cross an international border.

Ahaggar Cultural Park protection zones: the decree prohibits collection of cultural/natural objects, unauthorised mineral or fossil removal, and damage to wild plants. Do not wet, take moulds of, scratch, write on or detach rock-art surfaces. Organised professional film/photo activity requires prior culture-ministry permission and an agreement with the park office; normal tourist admission does not provide this authorisation.

sources.title: JORADP: Executive Decree 12-291, Ahaggar Cultural Park
sources.supports: Read directly: park boundaries and named control posts, organised protected-zone visits with appointed guide and prior agency authorisation, professional photography and rock-art/collection restrictions. Articles 28, 32 to 36.

local-law.note: Named cultural-park zones only. Original 2012/2014 instrument, not a verified current consolidation. Gate locations are mapped to present wilayas, not the older province labels. Current access, live zoning and later amendments not yet checked. No fee amounts reproduced.
